sentences.text: It is informed that applicant no.2-Mr. Sita applicant no.3-Mr. Motiram Vitthal Taware have expired during the pendency of the application.
As such, the application has rendered infructuous to the extent of claim of the said applicants.
2. Heard Mr. Kanoujia, counsel appearing for the applicants.

He would invite our attention to the contents in the FIR, which has led to registration of Crime No. 333 of 2018 punishable under Sections 420, 465, 466, 467, 468, 471 read with Sections 34 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.

He would invite the attention of this Court to the factual matrix viz the ownership of the said premises in question in favour of the applicant nos.2 to 5 which was agreed to be sold to the applicant no.1 by Navnath Baban Nikam And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164598856/
1 an agreement of sale dated 23rd September, 2016.

entities.text: Navnath Baban Nikam And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: According to bipin prithiani 30-apl-346.20.doc him, the complainant was using the said shop premises on leave and licence basis and so as to grab the said property, has falsely implicated the applicants in the offence in question.
He would urge that the complainant has also filed a Civil Suit being No. 1054 of 2017, which is pending on the file of the City Civil Court.
In this background, his contentions are in a dispute of civil nature, the applicants are falsely implicated in the crime.
3. Leave to amend to add complainant as party-respondent no.2.
Amendment to be carried out forthwith.
4. In view of aforesaid submissions, issue notice to respondents.
Learned APP waives notice for respondent no.1.

Issue notice to newly added respondent no.2, be served through respondent no.1,
returnable on 29th March, 2023.

5. Mr. Kanoujia, counsel appearing for the applicants, would also urge that even if it is claimed that the consideration was made the deceased mother of the applicant no.2, however, there is no evidence to that effect to substantiate such a claim.

According to him, based on false factual matrix,
the applicants are implicated in the offence.

[R. N. LADDHA, J.] [NITIN W. SAMBRE, J.]
